text:
Rina: Quick ask  were launching the benchmark + webinar next Thu. Need: 1) an X teaser thread that stitches to the webinar signup, 2) a longer LinkedIn article (or short post?) 3) hero asset specs, 4) SDR routing for webinar signups. Who wants to own?

Tom: I can do the X thread & schedule. Thinking 4 tweets: tease metric, short methodology, screenshot, CTA->signup. Also can stitch a short clip for the thread. ETA copy by 1pm.

Jules: Ill draft the LinkedIn article (800-1000 words) + a TL;DR short post. Which should we prioritize?

Rina: Both. LinkedIn article goes up same day as the webinar announce. Short post at launch. Keep article more story-forward (why the benchmark matters).

Bea: Assets: hero-1400x788.png, hero-square-1080.png, clip-9s.mp4. Anything else? Social-safe PNG for X header?

Tom: yes header_x_1500x500.png please. Also we should include UTM params and a param to indicate source=stitch (utm_source=x&utm_medium=stitch&utm_campaign=bench_webinar).

Rina: SDR routing: want webinar signups to go to /leads/webinar-bench-2024 and auto-assign to Webinar SDR queue. @SDR Bot can you create rule webinar_bench_signup -> Webinar SDR, priority=high, tag=organic_social?

SDR Bot: Created rule webinar_bench_signup -> Webinar SDR queue, priority=high, tags=[organic_social, webinar]. :white_check_mark:

Tom: Schedule proposal:
- Thu 09:30 PT: X teaser thread (stitch + clip)
- Thu 09:40 PT: LinkedIn short post (TL;DR)
- Thu 10:00 PT: LinkedIn article publish (link to signup)
- Thu 48h after: Follow-up thread w/ key takeaways + CTA to recording
Please use /schedule-post to avoid rate limits.

Jules: Draft article outline: intro problem, experiment setup, key metrics, caveats, how to reproduce, call-to-action (webinar). Will drop draft in Google Doc -> https://drive.google.com/example_jules_doc

Bea: uploading assets now -> https://drive.google.com/example_assets. Files: hero-1400x788.png, hero-square-1080.png, clip-9s.mp4, header_x_1500x500.png

Rina: engagement plan: Bea, prep 3 seed comments for X (short). Also pin official reply that points to signup.

Bea: seed comments:
1) "This made us rethink latency budgets  can't wait to share details in the webinar."
2) "Methodology is in the appendix  reproducible steps included."
3) "Ask Qs below and we'll answer live Thurs."

Tom: scheduling-bot note: use metadata ab_test=false for this run, but leave space for a later A/B on CTA text.

scheduling-bot: Reminder: use /schedule-post and attach UTM string. Also we can enable auto-pin on X threads.

Rina: final: Tom queue X thread and short post; Jules finish article; Bea confirm assets and seed comments; SDR Bot rule looks good. We'll reconvene Thu 08:45 PT for pre-launch check. :rocket:
